short: Behind: 26.61% WER is four times the 6.67% holdout baseline on the same recordings; the T15 best-result claim fails, the scoring split is unnamed and the gaze interface is untested.
position: iPhoneme changes the decoder (M06) and language model (M07) of the standard phoneme-CTC-plus-LM cascade. On recordings of the same participant its 26.61% WER is four times the 6.67% offline RNN baseline on the Brain-to-Text 2025 holdout, and Card et al. report 2.5% online in their final five sessions, so the claim of the highest performance on T15 does not hold; the 89% attributed to Card et al. names no metric and differs from the 90.2% and 97.5% word accuracies that paper reports. No scoring split is named while validation errors shape the LM and 150 decoder configurations were searched (M12). The lexicon-free phoneme 6-gram plus external LLM departs from the usual word n-gram but is never compared with it, so it is rated standard. The gaze-plus-phoneme confirmation interface (M09) has no user evaluation.
